effect_description_eng:
[On Play] This Digimon may digivolve into [OmniShoutmon] under your Tamers without paying the cost.
[On Deletion] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Play 1 Tamer card with the [Xros Heart] trait among them without paying the cost. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] This Digimon with the [Xros Heart] trait gains ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.).
